The previous recompute accepted a placeholder reviewer digest, a reviewer whose only output was the certificate itself, and dimension digests that do not follow from the evidence they cite; its release surfaces were also bound to a commit the remote has since passed.
blockerClasses.requiredOutcome: two genuinely independent reviewer outputs, dimension digests reproducible from the artifacts they cite, and a certificate recompiled against the remote at that moment via scripts/compile-four-plan-independent-certificate.ts --mode write.

nextExecutionOrder.outcome: Produce two reviewer outputs from reviewers that took no part in authoring the certificate or its evidence, each recording the input digests it recomputed from and writing to its own path. Renaming an actor does not create independence.
nextExecutionOrder.failClosedIf: fewer than minimumIndependentReviewers reviewers survive the certificate's own independence checks

principlesApplied: first-principles: completion requires current evidence, not historical prose or task status alone
deep-module: blocker classes expose stable seams instead of spreading one-off row logic through certificate code

false-green prevention: not-complete remains a valid, useful, machine-checked output
